CVE-2026-103658.title: aspell: aspell: Arbitrary code execution via crafted dictionary file
CVE-2026-103658.description: A flaw was found in Aspell. An attacker could achieve arbitrary code execution or cause a Denial of Service (DoS) by convincing a user to process a specially crafted dictionary file. This issue occurs due to an integer calculation error during buffer capacity checks in the read-only dictionary loader, leading to a heap-based buffer overflow.
